# NeuralNg Localization

IMPORTS
import { NeuralLocaleService, type NeuralLocale } from '@neural-ng/core/i18n';
import { neuralEn } from '@neural-ng/core/locales/en';
import { neuralTr } from '@neural-ng/core/locales/tr';

RULES
- Configure the initial locale with provideNeuralNg({ locale }).
- English is the fallback locale.
- Official complete locale entry points: en, tr, de, fr, es, pt-br, ar, zh-cn.
- Import the exact locale entry point; never import a locale registry or every
  locale eagerly.
- Locale packs are tree-shakable secondary entry points.
- Switch at runtime with inject(NeuralLocaleService).use(locale).
- Do not read navigator.language during component rendering or hydration.
- Use the same initial locale on server and browser.
- Component label and locale inputs override global locale messages.
- Partial custom messages deep-merge over English.
- Message interpolation is plain text; do not place HTML in locale messages.
- With provideNeuralNg({ direction: 'auto' }), NeuralNg follows the active
  locale and applies html[dir]. Explicit ltr or rtl configuration wins.

CONFIG EXAMPLE
providers: [provideNeuralNg({ locale: neuralTr })]

RUNTIME EXAMPLE
readonly neuralLocale = inject(NeuralLocaleService);
this.neuralLocale.use(neuralEn);
